text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Welcoming our second summer training camp 
together with Fine Motion—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "Fine, fight on~~! Yeahhh!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Of course! Because—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
This year for sure, I want to try every 
single ramen at the beach huts!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Considering nutritional balance, you can't 
just eat ramen all the time, can you?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That's why we couldn't conquer it last 
year... Besides, this year, we have races 
during the training camp, right?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Conquering it all is certainly a harsher 
road. But you see, I have a secret plan!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: That would be... "Gimme a bite♪"!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That's one of the things I learned at this 
academy! If we all share, we get to try so 
many kinds!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: And so, I'd really appreciate your help♪
choice_data_list: If you work hard at training...
If you work hard at training, okay?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Of course! That's a given, after all! 
...Whoops.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Shakur.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: *sigh*...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Your mind's totally made up, huh.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You will play the role exactly as 
scripted.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I'm sorry, I can't become a god.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I'll play a top-notch role for 
you. I'll put on a run that will make your 
heart leap.”

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: So... Could I at least become an angel?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Are you stupid?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"I don't need gods or angels. If you're 
not gonna do it..."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Ain't got no choice but to do it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, the reason why Air Shakur is 
so fixated on Fine Motion remains unclear. 
However—
choice_data_list: Looks like you've made up your mind.
Looks like you've made up your mind.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'm sure she'll keep forging ahead, 
straight toward the wall.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I have to work hard and get much stronger, 
too!
